_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. bindHost 127.0.0.1 = proxy reachable only from THIS machine (in prod, GoLogin runs on the SAME VPS as this server, so localhost is correct). controlPort takes the agent's outbound WS; in prod put it behind TLS (cloudflared/nginx) and the agent uses wss://.
_rootfs_alert_comment: Page when a Pi reports a WRITABLE rootfs? Leave false while the v1 golden image ships without the read-only overlay ON PURPOSE (deploy/pi/golden/customize-stock-image.sh) — otherwise every device in the fleet raises a permanent alert that can never clear and buries the real ones. Flip to true once the overlay actually ships, at which point a writable rootfs really is drift.
_claim_comment: CLAIM-CODE ONBOARDING (DB-backed identity). With claimPort set, dealerships are added HOT via the admin API + a one-time claim code — no restart, no hand-edited dealerships[] below. storePath persists identities. publicControlUrl is the wss:// URL handed back to a claiming agent (what it dials); publicClaimUrl is echoed to the operator for convenience. Put claimPort behind TLS/nginx (POST /claim, GET /health) exactly like controlPort.
_dealerships_comment: OPTIONAL / legacy. Pre-existing hand-provisioned dealerships. They are imported into the store once (marked already-claimed) so an old config keeps working. New dealerships should be created via the admin API instead.
